title: Setup: build Checkstyle at both #14128 revisions and run HiddenFieldCheckTest
description: Setup for case M08 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-m01-m10-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-m01-m10/worktrees, Maven 3.10.0 on JDK 17 with lint and report plugins skipped: builds Checkstyle (10.12.7-SNAPSHOT) at the fix pin d150018d141294ac9bb02ae653d01072c5c4c4ae (online first, then offline) and the parent pin d3f020a5c477edbb57afc0f3fa2d1fab0849d6fb, running only HiddenFieldCheckTest; keeps both jars, the HiddenFieldCheck class digests and the runtime classpaths; then runs the fix's HiddenFieldCheckTest with its two new resources-noncompilable inputs on a copy of the parent (expected to fail), and the Checkstyle CLI once at each pin on a setup smoke file. A Checkstyle build compiles its 439 main sources, runs its generators and compiles over 750 test-side sources (src/test/java, src/it/java, src/xdocs-examples/java), so the runs are a job. Dependencies and lifecycle plugins up to compile were resolved inline first.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent HiddenFieldCheckTest pass online and offline; the transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED; both CLI runs print XML naming HiddenFieldCheck; the trees are removed
